provenance: Bodies are the robots.txt files Claude read from each origin on 2026-11-26 through a cloud browser (PR #7 comment 7179991488). Whitespace was normalised to one directive per line with a blank line between groups; directives and their order are unchanged. api.data.gov.my returned HTTP 404.
